transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I’ve been having a really hard time lately because I just can't seem to stay in my seat or sit still when I'm supposed to. On top of that, I'm finding it really difficult to focus and actually finish my chores or any work.
Do you also often interrupt others, blurt out answers, or have trouble waiting your turn?
Yes, I definitely struggle with that a lot. I find it really hard to wait my turn, and I constantly catch myself interrupting people or jumping into conversations and activities.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were the three ADHD presentations. Based on the interview, the patient endorses both prominent inattentive symptoms (difficulty focusing and finishing chores/work) and hyperactive/impulsive symptoms (can’t stay in seat, difficulty waiting turn, interrupting others). This makes the predominantly inattentive and predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentations less likely, leaving ADHD combined presentation as the best fit.

inference_history.note: Based on the initial report of both difficulty staying seated/sitting still and difficulty focusing and finishing tasks, the ADHD spectrum remains the best fit. Compared with the broader differential, there is no evidence yet for mood, psychotic, anxiety, trauma-related, or eating disorder symptoms. Because both inattentive and hyperactive/impulsive symptoms are present, the candidates are narrowed to the three ADHD presentations rather than a non-ADHD diagnosis.
